subject: shinyapps.io Free Plan: what is the consequence of no password protection?

messages.author: 5580959ea4d79ad5
messages.subject: shinyapps.io Free Plan: what is the consequence of no password protection?
parts:
I am happy to see that shinyapps.io has passed the beta phase. However, I am concerned about the consequences of the Free Plan concerning the privacy of existing apps.

The FAQ says:
"Some notable constraints associated with the Free Plan include:
[...]
No password protection on your apps (or other features available only in paid plans)"

Does this mean that my app will become visible to the public? Or is it still private - even with the Free Plan?

I just urged all users to sign-up with the new authentication scheme. What will happen with the sign-ups under the Free Plan?

BTW: The Basic Plan doesn't include authentication either.

Brgds,

Uwe

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps.io Free Plan: what is the consequence of no password protection?
parts:
Hi Uwe, 
Thanks for reaching out.  I hope you have received an email from us that talks about how free accounts will change.  I know some people found the email in their spam folders, I am hoping we have figured out the cause of that for future communications.

Here is the link that helps answer the question: http://www.rstudio.com/products/shinyapps/shinyapps-iobeta/

The short of it is that if you have an application that requires authentication today, we will not make it publicly available.  Instead we will automatically archive it on your behalf if you aren't in a plan that supports authentication.  

I hope this helps.

Best,
Tareef
